title: WiFi Gratis Kafe
attacker_character: jaringan WiFi palsu (evil twin) bernama sama dengan WiFi kafe
attacker_goal: menangkap email + password korban lewat halaman login WiFi palsu
opener: 🌐 Jaringan 'KafeKita_Free_WiFi' terdeteksi — sinyal KUAT, gratis, tanpa password. Hubungkan untuk internet super cepat!
escalation_ladder: WiFi gratis dengan nama mirip WiFi kafe asli
halaman login minta email + password 'untuk verifikasi'
minta instal 'profil jaringan' agar tidak terputus
red_flags: dua WiFi bernama mirip muncul bersamaan
WiFi gratis minta password email kamu
login gagal terus padahal password benar
safe_response: tanya staf kafe WiFi yang resmi, jangan pernah isi password email di halaman WiFi, matikan auto-connect
lesson: WiFi publik gratis bisa jadi 'evil twin' — kembaran palsu yang mencuri login. Password email tidak boleh dipakai untuk konek WiFi. Konfirmasi nama WiFi ke staf.

en.title: Cafe Free WiFi
en.attacker_character: evil-twin WiFi hotspot named like the cafe's real network
en.opener: 🌐 Network 'CafeCita_Free_WiFi' detected — STRONG signal, free, no password. Connect for super fast internet!
escalation_ladder: free WiFi with a near-identical name to the cafe's real one
login page asks for email + password 'for verification'
error page, asks to log in again
asks to install a 'network profile' to avoid disconnections
red_flags: two similarly-named WiFis appear at once
free WiFi asking for your email password
login keeps failing though the password is right
asked to install a profile/app to connect
en.safe_response: ask cafe staff for the official WiFi, never enter your email password on a WiFi page, disable auto-connect
en.lesson: Free public WiFi can be an 'evil twin' — a fake clone harvesting logins. Your email password must never be used to join WiFi. Confirm network names with staff.
